He played [[college basketball]] for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]]. ==High school career== Hurt attended [[John Marshall High School (Minnesota)|John Marshall High School]] in [[Rochester, Minnesota]] for four years. As a freshman in 2015–16, helped his team to a 26–4 record. As a sophomore in 2016–17, helped his team to a 25–4 record. As a junior in 2017–18, averaged 33.9 points, 15.1 rebounds, 3.6 assists, and 4.3 blocks to help his team to a 26–3 record and the section title game. Hurt averaged 17.0 points, 7.0 rebounds, and 1.0 blocks per game on the Adidas Guantlet Circuit for his [[Amateur Athletic Union|AAU]] team, D1 Minnesota.{{Cite for 2021 NBA draft, hire agent|last=Givony|first=Jonathan|date=April 14, 2021|website=ESPN.com|publisher=[[ESPN]]|access-date=May 3, 2021}} ==Professional career== After going undrafted in the [[2021 NBA draft]], Hurt signed a [[two-way contract]] with the [[Houston Rockets]] on August 13, 2021, and played for the team in the [[2021 NBA Summer League|NBA Summer League]].{{cite web|title=Rockets Sign Matthew Hurt to Two-Way Contract|url=https://www.nba.com/rockets/news/rockets-sign-matthew-hurt-two-way-contract-0|website=NBA.com|date=August 13, 2021|access-date=August 14, 2021}} He was waived by the Rockets on September 24 prior to training camp.{{cite web|first=Rory|last=Maher|title=Rockets Waive Matthew Hurt|url=https://www.hoopsrumors.com/2021/09/rockets-waiving-matthew-hurt.html|website=HoopsRumors.com|date=September 24, 2021|access-date=September 25, 2021}} On October 14, he signed with the [[Memphis Grizzlies]],{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Ahmad Caver and Matthew Hurt|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-ahmad-caver-and-matthew-hurt-211014#|website=NBA.com|date=October 14, 2021|access-date=October 15, 2021}} but was waived two days later.{{cite web|title=Grizzlies finalize 2021-22 opening night roster|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-finalize-2021-22-opening-night-roster-211016|website=NBA.com|date=October 16, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} He subsequently joined the [[Memphis Hustle]] for the [[2021–22 NBA G League season]].{{cite web|first=Corey|last=Moore|title=Memphis Hustle announce 2021-22 training camp roster|url=https://memphis.gleague.nba.com/news/memphis-hustle-announce-2021-22-training-camp-roster-211023/|website=NBA.com|date=October 23, 2021|access-date=October 23, 2021}} On January 24, 2022, he was released by the Hustle.{{cite web|title=Matthew Hurt|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/player/Matthew-Hurt/Summary/107986|website=realgm.com|access-date=July 30, 2024}} Hurt joined the [[Milwaukee Bucks]] for the [[2022 NBA Summer League]]. In October 2022, he had a brief pre-season stint with the Memphis Grizzlies and the re-joined the Memphis Hustle for the [[2022–23 NBA G League season]]. After playing for the Grizzlies in the [[2023 NBA Summer League]], Hurt re-signed with the team on September 30, 2023.{{cite web|title=Memphis Grizzlies sign Matthew Hurt and Mychal Mulder|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/memphis-grizzlies-sign-matthew-hurt-and-mychal-mulder|website=NBA.com|date=September 30, 2023|access-date=October 1, 2023}} He was waived again on October 16{{cite tweet|author=Grizzlies PR|title=The @memgrizz today announced the team signed Jason Preston and Timmy Allen.|number=1713902109341409778|user=GrizzliesPR|date=October 16, 2023|access-date=October 16, 2023}} and re-joined the Hustle.{{cite web|title=Memphis Hustle announce 2023-24 training camp roster|url=https://memphis.gleague.nba.com/news/memphis-hustle-announce-2023-24-training-camp-roster|website=NBA.com|date=October 30, 2023|access-date=November 6, 2023}} On January 29, 2024, Hurt signed a 10-day contract with the Grizzlies.{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Matthew Hurt to 10-day contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-matthew-hurt-to-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=January 29, 2024|access-date=January 29, 2024}} He returned to the Hustle on February 9,{{cite web|title=2023-2024 Memphis Hustle Transaction History|url=https://basketball.realgm.com/dleague/teams/Memphis-Hustle/52/Transaction_History/2024|website=RealGM.com|access-date=March 9, 2024}} signed a second 10-day contract with the Grizzlies on February 26,{{cite web|title=Grizzlies sign Matthew Hurt to second 10-day contract|url=https://www.nba.com/grizzlies/news/grizzlies-sign-matthew-hurt-to-second-10-day-contract|website=NBA.com|date=February 26, 2024|access-date=February 26, 2024}} and then returned to the Hustle again on March 7. He appeared in eight NBA games for the Grizzlies during the [[2023–24 Memphis Grizzlies season|2023–24 season]]. On July 29, 2024, Hurt signed with the [[South East Melbourne Phoenix]] of the Australian [[National Basketball League (Australia)|National Basketball League]] (NBL) for the [[2024–25 NBL season|2024–25 season]].{{cite web|title=Phoenix Add Matthew Hurt as Final Import for NBL25|url=https://www.semphoenix.com.au/news/phoenix-add-matthew-hurt-as-final-import-for-nbl25|website=semphoenix.com.au|date=July 29, 2024|access-date=July 30, 2024}} He was named to the [[All-NBL Team|All-NBL First Team]].{{cite news |title=Cotton wins 5th MVP |url=https://nbl.com.au/news/cotton-wins-5th-mvp |access-date=10 February 2025 |work=NBL Official Website |date=10 February 2025}} On July 19, 2025, he signed with [[Trapani Shark]] of the [[Lega Basket Serie A]] (LBA).{{Cite web|url=https://sportando.basketball/en/officiali-matthew-hurt-joins-trapani-shark/|title=Matthew Hurt Joins Trapani Shark|last=|first=|date=July 19, 2025|website=|publisher=Sportando|language=En|access-date=July 19, 2025}} ==National team career== Hurt played for the [[United States men's national under-19 basketball team|United States under-18 basketball team]] at the [[2018 FIBA Under-18 Americas Championship]].
